text: The pipeline check. The sculpture's own word, KRYPTOS, repeats under all 97 carved letters, and each carved letter is shifted back by the key letter above it on the sculpture's table.
The reading is nonsense, and only 2 of the 24 known places come out right, at places 31 and 66. That is what chance gives.
It proves the harness: decrypt, re-encrypt, gate, score and record all run end to end. It was never expected to work.
